description: Submit a contact request to IA-Asso.fr (correction, feature request, question, or other). Used when users want to report errors, suggest features, modify association information, or ask questions. Requires user email and message. Workflow: collect email conversationally, then submit request. Requires an authenticated session (OAuth token or personal access token with scope contact:relay); anonymous agents should use contact_association instead, or point the user to https://ia-asso.fr/contact.

association_id.description: RNA ID of association if applicable (format: W followed by 9 digits)

email.description: User email address for follow-up (required, must be valid email)

message.description: Detailed description of the request (required, min 10 characters)

type.description: Type of request: correction (modify association info), feature_request (suggest feature), question (ask question), other (general inquiry)

name: submit_contact_request
